noir-detective.about: Grand piano, upright-style bass, brushed drums and a brass section: a 1940s-50s detective/mystery cue. Noir stories, case files, 'here's what really happened' reels.

noir-rusted-maid.about: Dark neo-noir jazz loop, piano and saxophone, smoky and late-night. Noir hooks, mysteries, short reels (loop it for longer ones).

warm-12-string.about: Solo 12-string acoustic guitar, 90s-style chords and sweeping arpeggios, no drums; fades in. Papercraft and personal stories, slow warm explainers.
warm-12-string.source: simple 1990s acoustic guitar tune - looping riff by Johnmode — https://freesound.org/people/Johnmode/sounds/827095/

warm-ukulele.about: Solo ukulele, a simple fingerpicked pattern recorded live; gentle and handmade. Papercraft stories, cosy how-tos, small-business reels.

bright-full-of-energy.about: Pizzicato strings, glockenspiel, vibraphone and tuba: a curious 'off on an adventure' motif. Quirky explainers, 'how it works' reels, playful openings.

bright-happy-guitar.about: Acoustic guitar over a light, groovy drum loop; cheerful and playful. Explainers, product walk-throughs, tips lists. ~3 s of silence at the end.

laid-back.about: Laid-back electronic beat with more movement. Product demos, punchy explainers.
laid-back.source: Laid Back Electronic Beat by Seth_Makes_Sounds — https://freesound.org/people/Seth_Makes_Sounds/sounds/716499/

wonder-emotional-piano.about: Emotional solo piano joined by strings; slow and tender, leaning sad. Reflective stories, before/after, heartfelt endings. Music ends at ~57 s.

wonder-slow-cinematic.about: Slow semi-epic piano with strings and soft pads; wide and emotional. Reveals, big-picture moments, endings. ~2 s tail of silence.

tension-documentary.about: Steady pulsing strings and arpeggios, nervous and mysterious but not horror; very even level. Investigations, 'the problem' acts, data reveals.

tension-orchestral.about: Orchestral suspense: dark clusters and a driving 120 bpm pulse, a chase/snooping feel. Cliff-hangers, stakes, countdowns. Music ends at ~84 s (7 s silent tail).

hopeful-upright-piano.about: Improvised uplifting piano in C major on a real (slightly out-of-tune) upright, natural room reverb. Hopeful turns, gentle endings, honest founder stories.
hopeful-upright-piano.source: Lighthearted piano tune excerpt by jay_mar — https://freesound.org/people/jay_mar/sounds/567165/

hopeful-wonders.about: Acoustic guitar, drums, strings and keys that build towards cheer and awe. Rising arcs, 'it worked' turns, launches. Trimmed to the first 119 s (53 bars) with a 4 s fade.
hopeful-wonders.source: Wonders [cinematic background music][107 bpm] by Seth_Makes_Sounds — https://freesound.org/people/Seth_Makes_Sounds/sounds/814843/

holy-water.about: Darker hip-hop instrumental with a heavy sub; moody. Serious or reflective lo-fi reels.
holy-water.source: Holy Water | Hiphop Instrumental by kontraamusic — https://freesound.org/people/kontraamusic/sounds/787544/

last-winter.about: Sub-heavy hip-hop instrumental, steady and calm. Talking reels, lo-fi vlogs, calm explainers.
last-winter.source: Last Winter | Hiphop Instrumental by kontraamusic — https://freesound.org/people/kontraamusic/sounds/788482/

lofi-loop.about: Classic lofi hip-hop loop, warm and soft. Aesthetic edits, study/cosy reels.
lofi-loop.source: Lofi Hip Hop Loop by TheWandermiles — https://freesound.org/people/TheWandermiles/sounds/708776/

space.about: Spacious hip-hop instrumental, airy top, deep low end. Polished, night-time or aesthetic reels.
